decision_rule: Qualification is two native dedicated server lifecycles only and yields no occupancy/performance verdict. Full A1 requires 20 decode-only rows, >=2 during-decode samples each, fixed expected neighbour occupancy, matched occupancy within 5%, positive drafted counts, no drafter/spec configuration and no request-local zero; missing native no-draft draft_n is UNKNOWN, explicit reported draft_n must be zero, two own-PID HIP/VRAM samples, distinct server PIDs and verified PID/port teardown before the next variant. Derive L3 loss only from full mode, versus mean L0 base/after; no production deployment or global KVU-16h completion implied.
